stories.title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made a new tool for programmers to use with their keyboard. It's designed for people who write computer code.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you write computer code for work, this doesn't affect you — it's a specialist tool for programmers.

stories.title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
stories.simple_summary: A new AI company is raising money to automate routine computer tasks that people do every day, like copying information between programs.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually make some office jobs faster and easier, but it's still being developed — nothing to worry about right now.

stories.title: A winner of math’s top prize says AI will soon surpass mathematicians. He fears what comes next
stories.simple_summary: A world-class mathematician says AI will soon be better than humans at solving math problems, and he's concerned about what that means.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to mathematicians and researchers — it doesn't directly affect everyday life or small businesses yet.

stories.title: Midjourney bought the astrology app Co-Star
stories.simple_summary: Midjourney, a company that makes pictures with AI, bought an astrology app that gives daily horoscopes to millions of users.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use the Co-Star app for fun horoscopes, Midjourney now owns it — but the app should still work the same way.

stories.title: Nvidia, Microsoft and other tech giants back open-source AI models
stories.simple_summary: Major tech companies like Nvidia and Microsoft are supporting open-source AI models, meaning they're sharing AI technology freely instead of keeping it secret.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly of interest to investors and tech companies — it helps competition and innovation, but you won't notice a direct change.

stories.title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.simple_summary: An AI company bought another company to improve how their AI assistant talks to people and works with them.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to software engineers and investors — it's about making AI assistants friendlier and easier to work with.

stories.title: SpaceX at $100 Would Imply Zero AI Value, Morgan Stanley Says
stories.simple_summary: A finance expert says that SpaceX's value shouldn't include any credit for AI, because the company doesn't really use AI in major ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for stock investors — nothing you need to think about unless you own SpaceX stock.

stories.title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
stories.simple_summary: Google is directing fewer people to regular websites because people are now asking Google's AI for answers directly instead of clicking through to web pages.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a small business website, you might get fewer visitors from Google search in the future — this is a real concern worth watching.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5 that costs less money and has fewer restrictions than their previous model.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Anthropic's AI assistant Claude, it might become cheaper or easier to use — but this is mainly for businesses and developers.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5 with ‘close’ to Fable 5’s capabilities
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new AI model called Opus 5 that works almost as well as their previous top model but is cheaper and more flexible.
stories.why_it_matters: Businesses using AI might save money, but for typical small business owners, this is mainly a technical update worth monitoring.

stories.title: Meta is making its AI chatbot more like an assistant
stories.simple_summary: Meta is adding new tools to its AI chatbot so it can look at your calendar and help you plan your day, similar to what other AI assistants do.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI assistant, it will soon be more helpful for scheduling and planning — a useful upgrade for everyday tasks.

stories.title: OpenAI's HuggingFace breach heralds an unprecedented age of AI cyber warfare — contemporary LLMs have caused massive upheaval in cybersecurity, and it's only going to get worse
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI suffered a security break-in, and the article warns that AI tools are making it easier for hackers to attack computer systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a warning that AI is making cyber-attacks more dangerous — it's worth paying attention if you handle customer data or important business information.
